title: Identification documents
text: Candidates must bring the same original identification document that they used when they registered. Accepted documents are a valid passport or a valid national ID card of the Republic of Kazakhstan. Photocopies, photos on a phone and expired documents are not accepted. A candidate without a valid original document cannot take the test and the test fee is not refunded.

title: What to bring and prohibited items
text: Candidates may bring their identification document and a clear plastic bottle of water without a label into the test room. For the paper-based test, pencils, erasers and sharpeners are provided by the centre. Phones, smart watches, bags, notes and food must be left in the storage area. Any electronic device found in the test room leads to disqualification.

title: Late arrival
text: Candidates must arrive at the registration desk at least 30 minutes before the test starts. A candidate who arrives after the Listening test has started is not admitted to the written tests. Late arrival counts as absence: the test fee is not refunded and a transfer is not possible.

title: Enquiry on Results
text: A candidate who disagrees with the result can apply for an Enquiry on Results (re-mark) within 6 weeks after the test date. The fee is 58000 KZT. One or more skills can be re-marked. If the band score of any re-marked skill increases, the fee is refunded in full. The outcome is usually sent within 2 to 21 days.

title: One Skill Retake
text: Candidates who took the computer-delivered test may retake one skill (Listening, Reading, Writing or Speaking) within 60 days after the original test date. One Skill Retake is available only for computer-delivered tests. The retake fee is 72000 KZT. The new result replaces the old score of that skill only.

title: Transfer to another date
text: A booking can be transferred to another session of the same module once. A transfer request must be made at least 14 days before the original test date; later requests are not accepted except for documented medical reasons. The transfer fee depends on how many days are left before the test (see the fee table). The new session must take place within 3 months of the original date.

title: Cancellation and refunds
text: A candidate may cancel a booking. The refund depends on how many days are left before the test date: 75 percent of the test fee at 35 days or more, 25 percent between 14 and 34 days, and no refund at 13 days or less. Refunds are paid to the original payment method within 15 working days.

title: Medical cancellations
text: If a candidate cannot attend because of a serious illness, the candidate must submit an original medical certificate within 5 days after the test date. In this case the candidate receives a refund of the test fee minus an administration fee of 15000 KZT, or a free transfer. Medical cases are reviewed by a member of staff and cannot be decided automatically.

title: Results and Test Report Form
text: Results of the computer-delivered test are available online 3 days after the test. Results of the paper-based test are available online 13 days after the test. The paper Test Report Form can be collected at the centre or sent by courier. Results are never given by phone or e-mail.

title: Speaking test
text: The Speaking test may take place on the same day as the written tests or up to 3 days before or after it. The time of the Speaking test is sent to the candidate by e-mail 2 days before the test. The Speaking test cannot be moved to a different time on request.

title: Special arrangements
text: Candidates with a disability or a medical condition (for example a hearing or a visual impairment) can request special arrangements such as extra time, a separate room or a modified paper. The request and a medical document must be sent at least 6 weeks before the test date for modified papers and at least 2 weeks before for other arrangements. Every request is reviewed by a member of staff.

title: Candidates under 18
text: Candidates under 18 years old need written consent from a parent or legal guardian at registration. A parent does not need to be present on the test day. The rules for identification documents are the same as for adult candidates.
